# Importing tracking data

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(move)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(conflicted)


loginStored <- movebankLogin(username="AurorePonchon",
                               password="AlbaNoir0*")

gannets<-searchMovebankStudies(x="gannet",
                                 login=loginStored)[1]
metadata<-getMovebankStudy(study=gannets,
                           login=loginStored)
getMovebankSensorsAttributes(study=gannets,
                             login=loginStored)
reftable<-getMovebankReferenceTable(study=gannets,
                                    login=loginStored)
move.rouzic <- getMovebankData(study=gannets,
                                login=loginStored,
                              removeDuplicatedTimestamps=TRUE) 
 
save(move.rouzic,
      file=here("data","RawData","gannets_rouzic_raw.Rdata"))

 
 load(here("data","RawData","gannets_rouzic_raw.Rdata"))
 
all_rouzic<-move.rouzic@data %>% 
    dplyr::select(tag_local_identifier,
                  timestamp,
                  location_long,
                  location_lat,
                  barometric_height, 
                  ground_speed) %>% 
    rename(id=tag_local_identifier,
           datetime=timestamp,
           long=location_long,
           lat=location_lat,
           alt=barometric_height,
           speed=ground_speed)  %>% 
    arrange(id,datetime) %>% 
    mutate(id=as.factor(id),
           site=as.factor("Rouzic"))

 save(all_rouzic,
      file=here("data","RawData","gannets_rouzic_raw.Rdata"))

rouziclayer<- st_as_sf(all_rouzic)
st_write(rouziclayer,
         dsn=here("data","NewlyCreatedData","shapefiles"),
         layer="all_raw_gannets_rouzic",
         driver="ESRI Shapefile",
         delete_layer =T,
          delete_dsn = T)

```
